what_it_does: All analog circuits need a stable reference voltage to work correctly, but at very low supply voltages (0.8 volts), the traditional building blocks don't work well. This chip creates a stable reference using only the basic transistors found in standard chip fabrication, without special structures. It achieves excellent immunity to power supply noise (rejecting noise frequencies all the way from DC to over 1 gigahertz) and stays stable across a wide temperature range, all in a tiny area.
